item.title: Huntsville records significant drop in violent, major crimes in 2025
item.description: Despite being Alabama's largest and fastest-growing city, Huntsville experienced a continued reduction in violent and major crimes in 2025.According to the Huntsville Police Department, during the period, violent crimes dropped by 18%, while major crimes decreased 9%. Additionally, all annual report-listed offenses were reportedly slashed by 6%. "Crime data isn't abstract – it's personal," HPD Chief Kirk Giles said. item.description: The University of Montevallo has canceled the Turning Point USA "Pick Up the Mic" event featuring Bryan Dawson, founder and CEO of 1819 News, citing "security concerns," including plans for a campus walkout and threats against Dawson's safety. item.title: 4 takeaways from Auburn's 84-76 loss to No. 19 Vanderbilt
item.description: Auburn could not overcome a sluggish start against No. 19 Vanderbilt, dropping its third-straight game 84-76 on Tuesday in Neville Arena.
